goals.title: Fix the deployed GitHub Pages portfolio so Chrome loads the productio...
goals.objective: Fix the deployed GitHub Pages portfolio so Chrome loads the production Vite bundle without site-owned CSP, asset 404, or favicon errors. Remove conflicting deployment behavior, retain the /Personal_Website/ base, verify desktop and mobile in real Chrome, and stop any iteration that exceeds 45 minutes or exhausts available credits.

successCriteria.scenario: Build production output, serve dist under /Personal_Website/, then load it in real Chrome at desktop width; fail on page errors, site-owned console warnings/errors, or non-2xx first-party assets.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .qa/pages-runtime-repair/desktop.json and desktop.png plus server cleanup receipt.

successCriteria.scenario: Inspect built HTML and deployment workflows; require no invalid CSP module token, a resolvable favicon, and exactly one workflow capable of Pages deployment for the active release path.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .qa/pages-runtime-repair/artifact-check.json from parsed production HTML and workflow scan.

successCriteria.scenario: Load the production build in real Chrome at 375px width and exercise navigation/contact links with reduced motion enabled; require visible main content and no first-party failures.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .qa/pages-runtime-repair/mobile.json and mobile.png plus browser/server cleanup receipt.

codexObjective: Complete the durable ulw-loop plan in .omo/ulw-loop/pages-runtime-repair-20260711/goals.json, including later accepted/appended stories, under the original brief constraints; use .omo/ulw-loop/pages-runtime-repair-20260711/ledger.jsonl as the audit trail.
